notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for [b]Pizza Slice [/b]- our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from [b]August 26th[/b] until [b]September 16th[/b]. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"]Steam Store Page[/url][/u] and click the green [b]“Request Access[/b]” button to be viable for participation.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). 
[/p][h3]Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy![/h3][previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🍕About Pizza Slice[/h2][p][/p][p]If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area![/p][h3][b]Game features:[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][b]• The Dream - [/b]Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis. • [b]The Business [/b]- owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.[/p][p]• [b]The Buzz[/b] - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores. • [b]A cozy simulation [/b]- the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business. • [b]A portion for two [/b]- you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🥓What can you expect from the build?[/h2][p][/p][p]A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.[/p][p][/p][p]The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.[/p][p][/p][p]Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?[/h2][p]We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested, and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.[/p][p]Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.[/p][p][b]Build Information & Requirements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Platform[/b]: Windows PC via Steam[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b]: Partial Support[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supported Languages[/b] - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardware Minimum Requirements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer[/p][/*][*][p]Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz[/p][/*][*][p]4 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p]Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x[/p][/*][*][p]DirectX 11[/p][/*][*][p]6 GB free HDD Space[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45047327/e00c11da06afea0c97c450539317f9ff2161465d.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🤌How to Join?[/h3][olist][*][p]Go to the Pizza Slice Steam Page now. You can follow the link [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"]HERE[/url][/u].[/p][/*][*][p]Click on the [b]Request Access [/b]button found on the playtest section of the page.[/p][/*][*][p]That’s it! You’re signed in. Now patiently await for a confirmation email.[/p][/*][*][p]The playtests will begin on August 26th, 2025.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]👌Got questions?[/h3][p]The easiest way to ask us questions is by joining our Discord server and asking us directly. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdgxrgVF4rsFiLGxN6XXtLCul8Bc6Ar21tfewUVXyPhEJ7Qf6BMZ1GFIy80DV1hYG_lCxabprQ-e1bHlI4NI521-UceWfDo4kNNpgzg4V6_kZEOyjR0P9bHw58okn-N0ldqLyAIZg?key=4PCsGwNRpUgMuhXU8r85kA"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]See you at the table, really soon![/p][p][/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p]

notes.title: Solutions to the most common issues
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Bakers,[/h1]

We wanted to make sure that you can play our game without unknown crashes/bugs/problems that's why we we've prepared a solutions list that will help you with all the most popular issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/b01565d1f25d1751aaa8116ceb67c2ca40589f2e.png[/img]

[h3]1. Reset your profile before you start the game[/h3]
[b]Before you start playing the newest version of the game[/b], we highly recommend resetting your profiles for maximum benefits from the patch, due to the game's save system structure. Otherwise, we do not guarantee the correct running of the game, due to interference in the game system. 
[b]Warning! After resetting your profile, you will lose all progress and have to start over.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ee4df04746cd4c4a80b8497bfb8a4084f8fa4e60.gif[/img]

[h3]2. A solution to UE4 error reporting by ČZŪ | Ami_Miku[/h3]
If you happen to encounter a state of power failure, crash, etc. that makes the computer unable to run normally when you are playing the game, you will encounter a UE4 error when you open the Bakery Simulator at this time, and the error content is:
[i]An unreal engine process has crashed.
Assertion failed: [File: Unknown] [Line: 660] BulkData compressed header read error.
This package may be corrupt!
BakerySimulatorFull_Win64_Shipping[/i]

[b]Don't worry, it's just that the save file of your C drive is broken, delete the folder named "saved" from C:\Users\your user name\AppData\Local\BakerySimulatorFull[/b]

[h3]3. Verify Integrity of Game Files[/h3]
If you are missing textures or other content in-game or experiencing crashing while playing a game, you can have Steam verify that the game's files are installed correctly on the computer.
[olist]
[*] Restart your computer and launch Steam
[*] Next, you can either right-click the game in your Library or click the gear icon from the game's Library page on the far right
[*] From the drop-down menu, select Properties...
[*] Select the Local Files tab and click the Verify integrity of game files... button

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//1976/48bde6da12dec86f0d07bb36d4949ee02e3f5f3d.png[/img]

[*] Steam will verify the game's files - this process may take several minutes

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//1976/2633d7ae8d4b626f6b31dc918a571b5ce53cb323.png[/img]
[/olist]

[h3]4. How to disable Motion Blur By BaldyWookie[/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808520537
[b]Attention! This is not a supported solution, it has the potential to cause bugs in the game.[/b]

[h3]5. How to skip tutorial[/h3]
If you want to skip the tutorial, just press 'esc' during the tutorial and click 'skip'.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KtqegaL.gif[/img]

[h3]6. "My save is gone, I can't continue"[/h3]
When you have 2 or more profiles, after starting a game you can see no option to continue (grayed out). You need to click on the profile, choose the one you want to play with and there "continue" will work again.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DTw1ZjZ.gif[/img]

[h3]7. Check the system requirements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/55b905806306c76170046e87477f0e3515d1c5fb.png[/img]
[b]Make sure you have the latest drivers for your hardware, if not update them.[/b]

[h3]8. If you occur any problems that the above solutions don't help[/h3]
Provide us with a DxDiag of your machine (just press the Windows button, type in "dxdiag" and save all details) along with all files zipped from your game folder: [b]C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\BakerySimulatorFull [/b]
All other additional info, such as issue descriptions, steps to reproduce it and a video would be greatly appreciated. [b]Please send all the details and attachments to: help@bakerysimulator.eu 
[/b]


[i]Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!
Gaming Factory team.[/i]

notes.title: Bakery Simulator delivery patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Bakers,[/h1]

[h3]We have not forgotten about you![/h3]
We are sorry you had to wait a long time for this update, we understand your bitterness. 
Like always we wanted to make sure that patch does not bring new issues, so we had to test it thoroughly. Therefore, now we are proud to present you the latest update to our game! 
We hope you will like our new delivery system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/dfcfe5c5866738448cc34f8382f6cb915fd905fc.png[/img]

[b]Before you start playing the newest version of the game[/b], we highly recommend resetting your profiles for maximum benefits from the patch, due to the game's save system structure. Otherwise, we do not guarantee the correct running of the game, due to interference in the game system. 
[b]Warning! After resetting your profile, you will lose all progress and have to start over.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ee4df04746cd4c4a80b8497bfb8a4084f8fa4e60.gif[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.3.4[/h1]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Change in the tutorial: improved steps requiring the use of PLUCK and TRASH CAN, changed the amount of recognized bad ingredient in the bowl to 1g from 5g. 
- Change in mechanics: Courier. Courier available from the completion of the tutorial. Swapping the courier unlocking perk for a discount for deliveries. Basic courier costs change from 10% of the cost of the order to 5%. The first upgrade - 3% of the cost of the order. The second upgrade - 2% of the cost of the order. 
- Change in mechanics: time for deliveries. Expanding the delivery times x2 to avoid time pressure.
- Changed the amount of money when starting the game from 5000 to 1000.
- Change in the driving mechanics, new driving system has been implemented for both small car and truck, changing the driving aspect into more arcade-like. 
- Changed the camera angle in the City to top view. It is possible to adjust the field of view by scrolling the scroll of the mouse up or down. 
- Changed delivery points markers to make the more visible.
- Muffins: small and large forms can be thrown from the tray straight into the trash can. 
- Change in mechanics: muffins. Added LMB hold option to streamline the addition of muffin papers to trays and pouring mass in one fell swoop.
- Machine improvements: Improved Rounder Divider performance.
Save system: Removed crashes that could cause progress to be removed. 

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed bigger performance issues on the City level, the level should run smoothly on the recommended setup even with graphic settings set to „very high”.
- Fixed issues with FPS loss, providing more stability on all tiers of bakery and City level. 
- Fixed texture and lighting issues in certain districts of the City level. 
- Fixed game crashes on deliveries. 
- Fix for loss of input on USB devices.
- Fix: The trigger on the red tray in the rounder divider is too small.

notes.title: Bakery Simulator post-release patch!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Bakers,[/h1]

[h3]We have worked our buns off to deliver this highly anticipated patch, we hope that it will meet your expectations. We are sorry that it took so long but we wanted to make sure that patch does not bring new issues. We are satisfied with our work, we hope that playing our game will make you feel the same level of enjoyment![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/3ff631f53a7f9062bc59c748421bccadcf534982.png[/img]

[b]Before you start playing the newest version of the game[/b], we highly recommend resetting your profiles for maximum benefits from the patch, due to the game's save system structure. Otherwise, we do not guarantee the correct running of the game, due to interference in the game system. 
[b]Warning! After resetting your profile, you will lose all progress and have to start over.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ee4df04746cd4c4a80b8497bfb8a4084f8fa4e60.gif[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.2.8 [/h1]

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Change in the tutorial: improved steps requiring the use of PLUCK and TRASH CAN, changed the amount of recognized bad ingredient in the bowl to 1g from 5g. 
- Change in mechanics: Courier. Courier available from the completion of the tutorial. Swapping the courier unlocking perk for a discount for deliveries. Basic courier costs change from 10% of the cost of the order to 5%. The first upgrade - 3% of the cost of the order. The second upgrade - 2% of the cost of the order. 
- Change in mechanics: time for deliveries. Changing the time to longer deliveries to avoid time pressure.
- Closing the exit to the city, using only the courier for deliveries.
- City exit widget (tutorial) - graying out and blocking the "Call for delivery" button.
- Raise the amount of money when starting the game from 400 to 5000$
- City exit widget: hover on the grayed out "move to city" button causes the appearance of a pop-up with the under construction sign.
- Muffins: small and large forms can be thrown from the tray straight into the garbage.
- Change in mechanics: muffins. Added LMB hold option to streamline the addition of muffin papers to trays and pouring mass in one fell swoop.
- Machine improvements: Improved Rounder Divider performance.
- Save system: Removed crashes that could cause progress to be removed. 

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Fix for loss of input on USB devices.
- Fix: The trigger on the red tray in the rounder divider is too small.
- Fix: The bowl from the large mixer does not respond to the reset of the position.
- Fix: After the reset of the position, the largest bowl on the cart does not detach from the player. Also added resetting the position to the default.
- Fix: Fixed problem with disappearing slots on tables.

[b]About game crashes:[/b]
Remember that in case of ingame crashes, you should provide us with a DxDiag of your machine (just press the Windows button, type in "dxdiag" and save all details) along with all files zipped from your game folder: [b]C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\BakerySimulatorFull[/b]
All other additional info, such as issue descriptions, steps to reproduce it and a video would be greatly appreciated. [b]Please send it at: help@bakerysimulator.eu[/b]

We also have a request to save the logs communicated by Unreal Crash Handler and attach to the bugs along with the packed saved folder.

[h3]Once again we want to apologize to you all dear Bakers for any inconvenience related to our game. There is more work to be done and we are aware of that. [/h3]

Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!
Gaming Factory team.

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #96 “Helpful tips to the rescue!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]In the hustle of a daily Baker's life it's easy to get lost from time to time. Here is the way to always get back on your feet![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/7e4a9144e6b5d4e7879123f9b2d3089de0283842.png[/img]

Let's imagine that you've just received your new machine and you are so excited to finally try it. Sadly... you have no idea how to work it?! That might seem absolutely ridiculous however reality often is quite funny. A machine that you need might be exactly what you want but sometimes it's great to get yourself familiar with the technological advances! There is no instructor next to you though so you have to do on your own... or do you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/f3da1b05ba0ed92d68b5451ac01412083d861a60.png[/img]

Everytime you find yourself wondering how an exact feature of the game works you can simply press "H" button to access an encyclopedia! We've talked about that feature before but now we're making it even more approachable and easy to use. No more flipping through pages in search of the right corner of the book - instead just stand in front of the machine, "aim" at it and press the button! It's so easy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/a2dbf147cbe1dfa4ff155b1d73bddf7d8cdb02aa.png[/img]

This particular feature will work on variety elements of the game while still being accessible in the old way. As such everyone should be content - both people who like to methodically flip pages and learn more about the baking world and those who prefer to "go at it" immediately! We sincerely hope that you will have a lot of great time using of encyclopedia and its enhanced way of use. 

[i]Thank you for tuning in to our devlog - see you in the next one![/i]

Best regards,
Bakery Simulator Team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #95 “Moving Trays!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Logistics of your baking operation are very important - we have not forgotten to add a little convenience to your work area. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/858cafb3aa7b7cf444b3155e96b8213139623573.png[/img]

It would be really painful to run through your Bakery several times with a simple singular tray, right? Even more so if you decided to create and bake not 5 but for example 50 of your favourite muffins or croissants! As that is the case, Bakery Simulator will feature more than just a singular tray - that way you can work on several projects at the same time and be sure that you will manage all your orders on time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ef84119da4721ffb036059385ed1eba3515d0a49.png[/img]

We went a step further - what good is having several trays if you still have to move them manually one by one? Wouldn't it be better if you could use them all and transport them all at the same time? Definitely! That is why the Bakery will feature a special carts that you will freely use to move your trays from one side of bakery to another! Just look at how many trays it can store at the same time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/d5b7935ff3663accc53d31e937981dff03a193e8.gif[/img]

And now, for the most exciting thing - you can actually "drive" the cart yourself! Whenever you need it and wherever you want it to go - simply grab the cart and move it to desired place. Isn't that super convenient? Especially since your Bakery grows in size and navigating such cart becomes a true pleasure! 

[previewyoutube=2ZopQyeAW9A;full][/previewyoutube]

We definitely hope such features will make your life as a Baker even more fun!

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #92 “Where should my bread go to!?”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]You might think the question in the title is silly but if there are multiple orders and places to go it gets a little bit tricky![/h2]

Let's just say that we've successfully managed to avoid all of the roadblocks we've been talking about in the last devlog - or even better, we've planned our route and we're sure that nothing bad is waiting for us at the next curve. While that's important and recommended we should also remember about one extra little thing - the deliveries themselves might go to different clients! Now, that's of course not a problem, it's good to have multiple clients but what if... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/b6529169bb410a7720b7167dca193e4b400cfaef.png[/img]

...what if I tell you that we not only have several clients but those clients tend to have more than only one shop? Yes, that's the "trickiness" showing itself and keeping us on our toes! Our clients will gladly order your goodies - be it bread or croissants - but they will also want to have those delivered to a specific place which can differ depending on the order! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/95d6753badafa4426a387b4f8ef6197a39fdae17.png[/img]

Generally speaking, it means that we're minimizing the number of times when you'll have to drive to a certain location over and over again - we want the targets of your deliveries to be diverse and different so you can visit the whole city and not just some of it. Your clients will have different branches and you will have to navigate yourself properly to reach all of them (or just some of them, depending on the number of orders!). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/1b9a8a0723123c509ff8097cb2bd21ffa4e9f513.png[/img]

In other words - don't fall into a routine! Even if you know a certain client and you're sure you can reach their place solely depending on your memory - it's better to check whether it's definitely the same shop that is calling for your products this time! 

[i]See you again - in the next devlog - in the meantime imagine the sweet goodness awaiting you in the Donut Dude...[/i]

Best regards,
Bakery Simulator Team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #91 “What to do when the road is closed?!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]What?! Another blocked road? But I've got deliveries to finish![/h2]

It's almost never good to be late. Especially if we're talking about professional obligations. Everyone tends to get a little bit frustrated when deadlines are almost upon us. In our line of work that goes both for people in the Bakery, drivers and customers. But imagine what must a driver feel when he is already getting close to being late and then suddenly sees that the road he took is unpassable and he needs to find another one? Oh, the horror!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/a6089f1d83eabc5fe5e142ba4d2b7b276bad2d06.png[/img]

That's the life in the city though. Sometimes roads will get blocked and you need to be properly prepared for that possibility. Thankfully, we're not going to make it too difficult for you as we know that sudden changes to your carefully crafted plan might only irritate you. Instead, we'll give you an option to plan your delivery accordingly in order to avoid unnecessary stress and showcase your awesome planning/driving skills. Isn't that great? Before the delivery, you'll be able to check what roads are currently potential issue-makers and you will be able to plan your way around those points! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/e1e2b0b4c347816bab46a4a07112bd571a7f475c.jpg[/img]

The roadblocks itself might happen due to variety of reasons. Perhaps there was an accident and now you can't drive through as medical staff is tending to victims or maybe Police is trying to catch someone and they purposefully blocked some paths they believe to be escape roads. The accidents themselves might be different so you'll most likely see different situations while riding through the city. Of course there is also a chance that right now, in the crucial moment, a parade or protests are on-going... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/cde7416b1944b0d04687fee213adebd5dfe9ebae.png[/img]

Every day those blocked paths will change and every day you'll be able to check them before going out to deliver your goodies. Make sure to always check the map - it will save you a lot of problems! 

[i]See you again - in the next devlog![/i]

Best regards,

Bakery Simulator team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #89 “It's a new ride!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Deliveries are important and it's crucial to make them in style![/h2]

We've received a lot of great feedback regarding our delivery system and we want to assure you that we're looking into the possibility of making this particular part of the game more fun and interesting! We're starting with the car itself - we've noticed that we can make some improvements to the model to make sure you feel great while doing deliveries.

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #88 “Upgrading the Donut!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]What would life be without donuts?[/h2]

It's a scary thought, I know, the world without donuts wouldn't be as we know it today. We strongly believe that donuts might be a big part of making the world as is right now and we don't even want to imagine the chaos if they were suddenly to disappear. With that in mind, we've been recently working on a better donut machine and we're happy to showcase it in this devlog! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/49eab1266568cc76cdc02e64b4de0edd6829f7d1.jpg[/img]

Ah, just look at this beauty. We can't wait to see the donut-making process! First things first though - you'll need to provide this machine with some properly formed dough in order for it to work. Then you'll have to set the temperature of oil and start the machinery - be careful, you will be dealing with a hot, hot, hot oil! No worries though - a small led light will let you know whether the oil is cold (the red one) or hot (green). Just make sure to take a look before doing anything. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/23b4e7a6e85212488c9edd3c599d0f54b1708767.jpg[/img]

After correctly setting everything up you'll be able to start making your own donuts - they will appear in the upper part of the machine and slowly move toward the end of it. Just like in real life you will have to flip the donut so it's evenly fried on both sides. Failure to do so or keeping the donuts too long in the machine might spell their doom... and failed cooking which we really don't want to! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/20414cd3217ae386cabb25e51d58d8132e858ada.gif[/img]

You'll be able to see how your donuts slowly take the desired shape throughout the frying process. As long as you keep your cool (and keep your heat for the donuts) you should be able to do just fine! 

[i]See you again - pretty soon![/i]

Best regards,

Bakery Simulator team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #87 “Spice and Bakery!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Let's add some spice to our life![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/822d67de7cd5585baf096f2af35cde4d5f2e4f13.jpg[/img]

Well, look at that! That's a lot of spices! And what is even more fun - they're all at your disposal! During your daily baking endeavors, you'll be able to add certain spices to the mix that you yourself will have to choose and select. Adding that little bit of extra oomph to the recipe might just be an amazing way of ensuring that your creation tastes great and will be appropriately appreciated by your customers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/b476f20fba3a53625aa9dbe072d76e5acb07feda.jpg[/img]

Of course, you're also free to not use spices at all - it's an extra touch that might add something to your goods but if you select poorly you might ruin whatever you're trying to bake. For each of the recipes, there will be a spice that nicely complements the pastry but also one that will not work well together. As you continue playing the game and experiment with the spices you will slowly learn which one works great with particular products! Additionally - the in-game Bakerypedia will also have a subtle hint for you regarding the appropriate selection of the spices so you might want to spare a moment to read about the pastry you're currently trying to make. 

As soon as you find and use a good spice the information about it will be added to the Bakerypedia! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/464bdf6a158aba2b9c5962c0d7e652aab044e151.jpg[/img]

What is more, while you might not use the spices at all using the correct one will yield additional financial gain for your trouble! Consider it a nice gesture from your customers as they appreciate the extra step you took in order to satisfy them. 

While with spices we want to add an additional layer of gameplay to the game we also don't want to overcomplicate it - the spices will behave a little bit different compared to normal ingredients - for example, you will not have to worry about selecting the right amount of them - you can simply focus on selecting the right one! They will also be separated from other ingredients and will be placed in a different part of the Bakery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/68923009e4d1982ad9532c0530d0a6a002ee1dc5.jpg[/img]

Keep in mind that you will be able to use only one spice for a particular pastry - choose well... but if you make a mistake and want to correct yourself you can always do that by using the extractor tool! 

[i]See you again - pretty soon![/i]

Best regards,

Bakery Simulator team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #77 “Let's mix around a bit!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]There are some important things to remember when it comes to the topic of mixing your ingredient - let us review those![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/95b036fb26aec5cc6ebb33a48dde29f2c1ab000f.jpg[/img]

Mixing is all well and good but not if you forget yourself for a moment and add to much water to the mix. If the whole thing becomes too watery it will be difficult for the dough to remain it proper shape and consistency. In that case you'll be informed about that with the short information as visible on the screenshot above - now it's an easy road to fix your mistake and make sure that the dough will be properly... "watered", right? 

But there is also another side of this coin - you can also forget to add water to the mix or at least use an insufficient amount of it. Similarly as before you will be informed about it and you'll be able to fix your mistake. Of course if you choose to ignore the warning and go ahead with your initial mix you might encounter some issues along the road... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/f27d5c58bface961be67c2b68a33f9eeb8c09c73.png[/img]
[i]Instead of seeing "Perfect" you might see "Too wet" or "Too dry" - that will let you know something isn't right...[/i]

Now... what will happen if you mix some ingredients with no regards to the original recipe? Well... there's definitely no stopping you from doing so! You can even mix those ingredients together in a complete chaotic manner! 
...however don't expect results to be too great. They say that experimenting is always interesting but in the case of bread and buns it's better to stick to the recipe. To sum it up - if you see your mixer displaying "mixable" notice - you might have made a little mistake along the road. Better to revise your steps!

Let's take a look at mixing tooltip. Tooltips in general will help you recognize whether what you are doing at the moment is correct and what kind of mistake you might have committed. In this particular case you can easily see the problem - the culprit is overmixing. 

The tooltip indicates that while you've followed the recipe in regards to the ingredients (the green 100% next to the Breakfast Bun) the next step of the procedure was not completed properly. You might still continue with your baking however you need to take into an account that this particular set of buns might not turn out perfectly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/e3009945629b7c2eea69261b78501e920b47abb0.jpg[/img]

Baking itself is also prone to making mistakes. In one of the previous devlogs we've talked about making the  big ones - like setting your own creations on fire. In order to avoid that it's good to check periodically on things you've put in the oven. Right now, visible on the screenshot above, tooltip let us know that you should still keep your bun in the oven for a bit longer. However if you forget about it and put it there for too long you risk it getting burnt... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/91f26b11244b8844920a253e8be3365284ed1a96.jpg[/img]

Finally - after taking your buns from the oven you'll be able to check their final state and condition. In this particular case we've definitely overmixed it and burnt the buns a little bit. 

Now you face the final decision - do you still try to ship this particular batch of buns or do you want to redo it? Even if they are a little bit spoiled you might want to try to sell them however keep in mind that your score and reputation as a Bakery will take a hit as a consequence.

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #71 “UI to the rescue!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]You start adding ingredients to the bowl but then suddenly someone calls out to you. When you get back to your mix after a little chat with friend you don't remember anymore - what did you add? What should you add now?[/h2]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/2fac62f9871202d6354c67c1171b707f6a456655.png[/img]

We definitely understand how frustrating it is to forget about the right order of adding ingredients or exact proportions within which you should operate. Sometimes you lose concetration for a second and it's really hard to recall whether you've added 10g or 100g of sugar. It's especially problematic when you have a particularly strict recipe and you need to follow it completely to reach a certain result. No worries though! Our team was quick to realize that it might lead to some unsatisfying or straight-up irritating moments in the game and that is why we've prepared a solution for it. 
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/4208c27c2ea53e6370f4f7414d96ac9f8ba3ee7c.png[/img]
	
Take a look at the screenshots - as you can see every single ingredient that you've added to the bowl is displayed on the screen next to an appropriate bowl so you will not mistake it with any spare bowl you might have. Thanks to this solution it's easy to check what has already been done within your current baking process. Combining that with the note on the top right corner of the screen you can always easily check your progress.
		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/4572d63019b3fb64aaa2ed32eae51d85a5454393.png[/img]

In other words - when you'll be playing the game and you'll have to suddenly pause it for any reason - it will still be very easy to come back to it and continue from the point you left it off. You will face many challenges when baking and managing your own Bakery but we'll be sure to prepare many tools to make the whole journey very satisfying.

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #70 “Knowledge is power!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]There are many features, machines and tools in the game... so what happens if you forget the purpose of one of them? Well, then it's time to check the Bakerypedia![/h2]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/d761de80af68b857665413ba7903dd9e1782ff65.png[/img]

Bakerypedia is a powerful tool - it holds the answer for any and all question you might have for things laying around in your Bakery. Every single machine and tool is labeled in the book and you can quickly, with few clicks, access the information for each of them. Bakerypedia will explain how to use a certain feature, what are the requirements and what is the purpose of the selected tool/machine. 
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/6544535b781d50b30b3986ebf6d03a29cc84e025.png[/img]
	
For the enhanced ease of use we have separated the information in the Bakerypedia into few categories - machines, tools and various - the last one collecting all of the useful information you might want to check when playing the game. Machines tab cater exclusively to various installation you will find in your Bakery. It's here where you will learn how your oven works or what does the divider do. Be sure to check it often when using a particular machine. 
		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/afc6b168f9d9f1a99710bdad67704f0637ee4d29.png[/img]

In tools tab you will find information about smaller objects such as bowl or pluck. The text will explain its usage and what can accomplish using them through your playthrough. For example we can learn that pluck will help us in a miserable moment of clumsiness when we added a wrong ingredient to the bowl - it can gather it back and save us from misery. And if we completely messed up... well, you can read about trashcan too... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/aed02686f9d9530ce78ba23f3a58c3c78d469ee1.png[/img]

To sum it up Bakerypedia is a great place of knowledge that was designed to help you in your Baking career. Make sure to use and treat it well and you will definitely go far!

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #68 “Let's go shopping!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Oh, how wonderful it would be if shelves magically got full over the night...![/h2]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/31b86fa3b6b31957ee284bd586a537462d2e072a.png[/img]

That is however not the case. You know, every time you use some of the ingredients on your shelves you need to keep in mind that it is not magically or miraculously getting refilled. Doing your job will mean using up the ingredients you purchased for your daily duties. Purchasing new ingredients and restocking should be something that comes to our mind naturally however it is not always so. After all... we all know the feeling of forgetting about buying that one necessary thing after the shops have already closed... 
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/b85059002d8d36244e1c8182bca1487f813d3d9c.png[/img]
	
Additionally you will most likely not always use up all of your ingredients only on the succesful baking endeavours. Most likely sometimes you'll make a mistake - you'll add too much water to the mix or perhaps overpour the olive and the whole mix is ruined. Throwing away the ingredients that were incorrectly used might be painful however it is something that you will have to do... You want to deliver only the best quality of goods, isn't that correct?  
		
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/af5faf864589f7e215638dbdb19a0e4dc6a680f5.png[/img]

Thankfully Bakery Simulator will feature an option of restocking your shelves. You'll be able to go shopping and buy necessasry ingredients. There are limits! You cannot buy more than what your shelves can hold and obviously if you don't have money then it will be no shopping for you! However if your finances are doing okay and you have space on your shelves then you will be able to purchase as you see fit. You will even have a convenient option to purchase everything you lack by clicking on an option to select missing ingredients - what a luxury! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/1ea2df79b4e255bc7afebe98ca3df287a5a56f87.png[/img]

Don't panic then if you don't have enough to bake the buns or croissants requested by your customers. Extra shopping will always be an option!

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #64 “Delivery right on time…?”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]This time let’s talk a little bit about deliveries and making sure they’re on time![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/fbcc41de439b4d6e2abfccdc57a030167e3a66ea.png[/img] 

[b]While the weather might not be the best today for road trips – would a simple lightning storm be enough to stop you? Definitely not! No matter the weather, save perhaps for some really rare occurances, the show must go on and the deliveries should be made. Of course – as a player you will have a chance to hire someone to do that for you but if you like the deliveries and prefer to do them by yourself – a simple storm cannot stop you! Let’s check what options you will have at your disposal during deliveries.[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/5f3feafa19a2edd62698c0f0abf45d1cdfaefa71.png[/img] 
	
[b]First of all – while you always want to be fast, precise and accurate – sometimes life will have other plans for you. If you feel like you cannot do a certain delivery in time you might want to call the customer and inform them about the delay. Your customers might accept you being late once but even that kind of patience has its limits. You might be able to get some extra time for your delivery but make sure you can manage and don’t fail your customers’ expectations again![/b]

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #63 “Oops! – What to do when you make a mistake?”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Weeks ago we’ve talked about the possible accidents that might happen in the kitchen – this time we’ll talk about the possible mistakes and the simple way of dealing with them![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/bdeb5c2391a079b8bd239eb06bbfb7e44e87b235.png[/img] 

[b]Look at the screenshot above – can you see a problem? On the right upper side of the screen we can see a detailed information leading you step by step on how to prepare a Rye Bread – a specific product ordered by one of our partners. However, shamefully, we’ve made a mistake when mixing ingredients – red squares next to some of them mean that we’ve added to much of them to the mix and we will be unable to proceed smoothly as the final product will not turn out too good. It would be a bad thing to go through with next steps of the work… so what should we do now?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/b424cc40aad36c489075882ae498d9c145f4467b.png[/img] 
	
[b]Another example of failed work is above. While we might be able to fix some of the errors of our ways during the process – for example if we added not enough sugar while mixing ingredients we simply need to add more (the order of adding the ingredients does not matter here) on the screenshot above we see an example of work that we will be unable to salvage. Burned in a way that resembles a charcoal bread will not be eaten by anyone so we might as well get rid of it altogether… And that bring us to the solution for the problem – perhaps you have already spotted it on the screenshot?[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/e970841b82027c5d06852c73d97ca590266cea41.png[/img] 

[b]The good, old, ever-useful trashcan will help us in that kind of situations. We simply need to grab the failed effects of our work and throw it to the can – ensuring that we will not send it to our client by mistake or mistake it for anything else. If you’re sure that whatever you were working on cannot be used anymore – make sure to use the trashcan![/b]

[i]We believe in you and we know you won’t make too many mistakes but in case you do – trashcan is here to help![/i]
	
Best regards,

Bakery Simulator team

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #57 “Baking mini-games #2 - Croissant!”
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers![/h1]

[h2]Continuing our mini-series about baking mini-games this time we’ll take a closer look on croissants! Who wouldn’t like to take a closer look at them, right? Maybe even more than that?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/e6aa262227de8d0b1f39839f9092e49fc750e425.png[/img]

[b]Let’s assume for a moment that we have correctly prepared ingredients and jumped into the mini-game itself. First of all we need to take care of excessive dough. We don’t need that much of it to prepare yummy croissants, so let’s cut some and get rid of it. Perhaps we will use it at a later time? Or - if you are preparing a batch order for a lot of croissants you might want to use that for that particular task. Anyway - cut, cut, cut![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/aea1db4148fca9a4927c2570dccd29fa237e16ed.png[/img] 

[b]Okay, we managed to get just enough dough - now we get to use the rolling pin and make sure that our dough is rolled just thin enough for us to use for croissants. Make sure to roll hard - we cannot let our dough be too thick or we will fail miserably! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/20058093861fbbcff784ae05f70745975dc24d5c.png[/img]

[b]When we finish rolling we need to cut the dough into little (or larger) triangles. They kind of look like pizza slices, don’t they? Anyway, let’s not get distracted by thinking of pizza when we’re creating croissants! Slicing them is important and needs to be done manually as we need to make sure that from each slice we’ll get a tasty treat - perhaps for ourselves or for our customers.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/8bc9b4b48466a3bc8682b1c50734a75bf9428d3b.png[/img] 

[b]Finishing touches - we need to roll the slices into an appropriate shape. After all, croissants are easily recognizable thanks to their overall look and we cannot miss that fact. As soon as we are done with that we can start baking![/b]

[i]What do you think about the mini-games up until this point? Do you like them?[/i]

[h2]Do you know the old saying – “don’t play with fire”? Well, sometimes that particular phrase is very actual and important![/h2]

[b]When working in a bakery there are many opportunities to make a mistake – maybe you can simply forget about one of the key ingredients and the final effect of your baking is a little off? You managed to open the oven and place the carefully crafted future bread roll in it. And then, as you start baking, a friend calls you. You start talking with him, remembering good old times. After a while you remember – you started baking your bread roll! You carefully open the oven and then… Oh God![/b]

notes.title: Bakery Simulator ~ Devlog #47 "Checklist"
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Bakers! [/h1]

[h2]In this post we would love to share with you some new features of the game that our team is working hard on! This time it will be… a checklist![/h2]

[b]What’s the best way to make sure that everything you have to remember is neatly organized and you will not forget a single step of the baking process? Make a checklist and then follow it to the point! 
Notice how our checklists differ from each other depending on what we are doing within the game. [/b]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/d3ca2b3a992291b7c53936029ae935f4cd95170a.jpg[/img]

[b]On the left you can see how empty checklist looks like before we start doing anything. The right showcases the situation in which we properly grabbed the necessary amount of one of the ingredients. [/b]

[b]Similary – on the left you can see different states of progression regarding the amount of ingredients highlighted by varying state of squares next to ingredients. On the right side not only we have taken all the necessary ingredients but we also completed the first step of our baking process. [/b]

[b]The great thing about checklists is the fact that you always know on which step you are! Simply after doing a particular step – it should be crossed out to not forget that we have already done that part!
